import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import DREAM
from DREAM.Settings import DREAMSettings
from DREAM.Output import DREAMOutput

# --- 1. Initialization Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings()

# Radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(0.5)      # [m]
ds.radialgrid.setMajorRadius(1.65)     # [m]
ds.radialgrid.setNr(5)

# Time steps
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(5)

# Add ions (example: deuterium plasma with carbon impurity)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon(name='D', Z=1, n=1e20, iontype=ds.eqsys.n_i.IONS_DYNAMIC)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon(name='C', Z=6, n=1e18, iontype=ds.eqsys.n_i.IONS_DYNAMIC)

# Set up temperature and electric field
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(1e3)  # [eV]
ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(0.5) # [V/m]

# Disable runaway and hot-tail grid
ds.hottailgrid.setEnabled(False)
ds.runawaygrid.setEnabled(False)

# Save settings and run initialization
ds.save('settings_init.h5')
do = DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output_init.h5')

# --- 2. Ionization Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings('settings_init.h5')
ds.eqsys.n_i.setIonization(True)
ds.save('settings_ionization.h5')
do = DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output_ionization.h5')

# --- 3. Equilibration Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings('settings_ionization.h5')
ds.eqsys.n_i.setIonization(True)
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(1e3)
ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(0.5)
ds.save('settings_equilibration.h5')
do = DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output_equilibration.h5')

# --- 4. Radiation Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings('settings_equilibration.h5')
ds.eqsys.n_i.setIonization(True)
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(1e3)
ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(0.5)
ds.save('settings_radiation.h5')
do = DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output_radiation.h5')

# --- Analysis: Plot Ohmic heating and radiative losses vs temperature ---

# Define temperature range
Te = np.logspace(1, 4, 100)  # [eV]

# Prepare arrays for ohmic heating and radiative losses
ohmic = np.zeros_like(Te)
radiation = np.zeros_like(Te)

# Use the last settings for equilibrium ionization
ds = DREAMSettings('settings_radiation.h5')
ds.radialgrid.setNr(1)  # Single point for scan

for i, T in enumerate(Te):
    ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(T)
    ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(0.5)
    ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-6)
    ds.timestep.setNt(2)
    ds.save('settings_scan.h5')
    do = DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output_scan.h5', quiet=True)
    out = DREAMOutput('output_scan.h5')
    ohmic[i] = out.other.fluid.OhmicHeating.data[-1,0]
    radiation[i] = out.other.fluid.RadiatedPower.data[-1,0]

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.loglog(Te, ohmic, label='Ohmic Heating')
plt.loglog(Te, radiation, label='Radiative Losses')
plt.xlabel('Electron Temperature [eV]')
plt.ylabel('Power Density [W/m$^3$]')
plt.title('Ohmic Heating and Radiative Losses vs Temperature')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, which='both', ls='--')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
